documents.title: Master services agreement
documents.text:
Master services agreement — Meridian Vale Systems (fictional).
In this document "MVSH" means Meridian Vale Systems. Meridian Vale Systems reports maximum service credit of 18.3% for FY2025 (fiscal year ending 30 June 2025). Meridian Ltd reports termination notice period of 97 days for FY2024. Meridian Vale Systems reports approximately annual fee of $6m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Meridian Vale Systems reports insurance cover of $2.9m for FY2024 on a reported basis. For Meridian Vale Systems, the governing law is read as: English law, London-seated arbitration. The fiscal year of Meridian Vale Systems ends on 30 June.

documents.title: Amendment letter
documents.text:
Amendment letter — Meridian Vale Systems (fictional).
Meridian Vale Systems reports maximum service credit of 13.4% for LTM to 30 Jun 2025. Meridian AB reports termination notice period of 120 days for FY2024. Meridian Vale Systems reports term years of 6 years for FY2024 on a reported basis. Meridian Vale Systems reports uptime commitment of 127.51%. For Meridian Vale Systems, the governing law is read as: Swedish law, Stockholm courts.

documents.title: Supplier summary memo
documents.text:
Supplier summary memo — Meridian Vale Systems (fictional).
Meridian Vale Systems reports annual fee of $6.2m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Meridian Vale Systems reports insurance cover of $3.5m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Meridian Vale Systems reports term years of 7 years for FY2024 on a adjusted (management definition) basis. Meridian Vale Systems reports uptime commitment of 99.67% for FY2024.
